what: The illustrated map is pinned to the screen and a car runs along the road as you scroll (rotating with the path direction). The map follows upward by car distance traveled ÷ total road height × the map’s spare height, and each landmark passed pops out from .8 → 1 at its progress threshold — drive routes · walking trails · route guides.

options.screens: Screens to scroll further while pinned, default 6 (phone map is 4)
options.at: Progress values at which attractions pop out (space-separated, in order) — the first attraction appears right on entry. Example .125 .175 .225 .5
options.media: Condition under which this map runs (media query), default all. If you set separate landscape and portrait maps, only one runs each time, using (orientation: landscape) and (orientation: portrait).
options.[data-fx-part=viewport]: Frame fixed to the screen height (overflow hidden)
options.[data-fx-part=world]: One map — a single svg with its own viewBox, with roads, cars and landmarks all drawn inside it
options.[data-fx-part=route]: Road path — the route the car follows
options.[data-fx-part=car]: The g running along a road. Running direction follows data-direction (1 or -1)
options.[data-fx-part=spot]: Landmark g·a — children pop out. Inside it [data-fx-part=icon] is a + mark that appears .4s later
